title: Shout to the Lord
lyrics_original: My Jesus, my Savior,
Lord, there is none like You;
All of my days
I want to praise
The wonders of Your mighty love.
My comfort, my shelter,
Tower of refuge and strength;
Let every breath, all that I am
Never cease to worship You.
Shout to the Lord, all the earth,
Let us sing
Power and majesty, praise to the King;
Mountains bow down and the seas will roar
At the sound of Your name.
I sing for joy at the work of Your hands,
Forever I'll love You, forever I'll stand,
Nothing compares to the promise I have in You.

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా నా శైలము, నా కోట, నన్ను రక్షించు వాడునా కేడెము, నా రక్షణ శృంగము, నా ఉన్నతదుర్గము, నా దేవుడునేను ఆశ్రయించియున్న నా దుర్గము.
bible_verses.english: The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer; my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా, మేము మా చెవులతో వినినదంతయు నిజము, నీవంటి వాడెవడును లేడు, నీవుతప్ప మరి ఏ దేవుడును లేడు.
bible_verses.english: There is no one like you, Lord, and there is no God but you, as we have heard with our own ears.

bible_verses.telugu: సకలప్రాణులు యెహోవాను స్తుతించుదురు గాక యెహోవాను స్తుతించుడి.
bible_verses.english: Let everything that has breath praise the Lord. Praise the Lord.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, You are my Savior, my comfort, and my strength. There is no one like You in all the earth, and my heart longs to honor You with every breath I take. In times of trouble, thank You for being my refuge and tower of shelter. Help me to proclaim Your mighty love today with joy and unshakeable gratitude. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, You are my Savior, my comfort, and my strength. There is no one like You in all the earth, and my heart longs to honor You with every breath I take. In times of trouble, thank You for being my refuge and tower of shelter. Help me to proclaim Your mighty love today with joy and unshakeable gratitude. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: There is truly no one like Jesus. In moments of quiet need or roaring triumphs, He remains our safe shelter, faithful refuge, and unfailing comfort. When we pause to consider the wonders of His mighty love, our natural response is praise. May every breath we take today become a joyful declaration of His greatness, inviting the whole earth to join in exalting our Savior.
